_comment: A quest is a list of 'steps'. Finishing a step pays its own 'xp' and 'currency_reward', then the quest moves on to the next step by itself; the last step is handed in to an NPC. A quest with no 'steps' is one unnamed step written directly on the quest ('objectives', 'xp', 'currency_reward', 'item_rewards'). 'currency' names the kingdom that pays every step (0 Ennara, 1 Kingdom 1, 2 Kingdom 2, 3 Kingdom 3 - CurrencyId in world_regions.h); a quest that omits it pays in Ennara's coin. 'require_race', 'require_level' and 'require_quest' gate who may take it. Objective types: kill and talk (target_id is an npc_type_id), collect, buy and sell (target_id is an item_id; an optional 'marker_npc' names the NPC type the map points at). Dialogue shows an option at one step with the condition {"type": "quest_step", "value": <quest id>, "step": <step number from 1>}. The opening is 'Welcome to Ennara', seven steps: talk, buy, sell, talk, buy, sell, talk.

objectives.description: Sell a Health Tonic to Mirela
Sell the Fang Knuckles to Doran
Report back to the Courtyard Warden
